name: FireToken
fix_description: In _transfer, when selling (to == pair), the contract additionally deducts sellAmount from the pair balance and sends it to DEAD_ADDRESS, then calls sync(). This directly reduces pair token reserves and manipulates the price upward on every sell. Attacker exploits this by repeatedly selling small amounts to inflate price. Fix: remove the direct pair balance deduction and burn logic from the transfer function.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a multi-step DeFi exploit involving an Aave flash loan, Uniswap V2 fee-on-transfer token behavior, direct pair reserve manipulation, and a constructor-based bypass of an anti-contract transfer check. The vulnerability is not just a trivial access control issue; it requires understanding token transfer side effects, AMM reserve accounting, and why repeated contract creation is used, but the overall attack path is still fairly short and self-contained.
